subject.title: fix(shared): return "" from sliceUtf16Safe when end <= start, matching native .slice

question: Should `sliceUtf16Safe`, as exported through normalization-core and plugin SDK text utility surfaces, change reversed normalized bounds from swapped substring output to native slice empty-string output?
rationale: The source and proof support the fix, but the shipped helper is externally visible and external plugin reliance on the old swapped behavior cannot be ruled out from in-repo tests alone.

options.title: Accept Native Slice Semantics
options.body: Land this PR with the updated regression test and treat the old swapped behavior as a helper bug rather than a supported public contract.

options.title: Document Contract First
options.body: Add a small SDK-facing note or helper comment clarifying reversed-bound behavior before merge so external callers have a visible contract.

options.title: Pause For Compatibility Path
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a deprecation or alternate helper path for any external caller that may rely on swapped bounds.

recommendation.title: Accept Native Slice Semantics
recommendation.body: Land this PR with the updated regression test and treat the old swapped behavior as a helper bug rather than a supported public contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the helper behavior and recently moved the helper into the normalization-core package surface.
